title: Freezing Rain & Sleet on the Window - Crackling Woodstove | Winter Storm Sleep 8 Hours
description:
8 hours in the Stormwood Cabin kitchen during a winter ice storm: sleet and freezing rain ticking on the frosted window, wind outside, and a woodstove burning softly behind its iron door. No music, no talking.
The sound never loops, with a gentle fade in and a slow die-down at the end. Made for falling asleep, staying asleep and winter evenings.

0:00:00 The ice storm begins
0:00:10 Sleet and woodstove (8 hours)
7:45:00 The stove slowly burns down

Stormwood Cabin - Storms outside. Warmth inside.
New sessions every Monday and Thursday.

Scenes and sounds are original, created with AI tools and edited by Stormwood Cabin.

#winterstorm #sleet #sleepsounds
